FN-29RWKSK-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 9
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/06/2024
Senate Bill 9 as introduced would establish a process for a Class 1 municipality to petition for
judicial in rem foreclosure of certain municipal code enforcement and nuisance abatement liens
on property that is not owner occupied.
In doing so, this bill would allow a Class 1 municipality to recover the amount of unpaid
municipal code and nuisance abatement liens and costs of municipal code enforcement through
court-ordered sale of property that is not owner-occupied.
In addition, this bill could increase revenues, by an undetermined amount, to any state or local
entity that would ordinarily receive property tax revenues from taxes on the not owner-occupied
property being sold.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 9
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 9 as passed the Senate would establish a process for a Class 1 municipality to
petition for judicial in rem foreclosure of certain municipal code enforcement and nuisance
abatement liens on property that is not owner occupied, which would allow the municipality to
recover the amount of unpaid municipal code and nuisance abatement liens and costs of
municipal code enforcement through court-ordered sale of property that is not owner-occupied.
In addition, this bill could increase revenues, by an undetermined amount, to any state or local
entity that would ordinarily receive property tax revenues from taxes on the not owner-occupied
property being sold.
